title: Sport, Fitness, and Habits
summary: Lifestyle, routines, habits, and advice around health and fitness.
whyItMatters: Fitness conversations combine activities, frequency, goals, motivation, and realistic changes to everyday routines.

mentalModel.title: Describe the current habit
mentalModel.content: Name the activity, frequency, duration, and how it feels.

mentalModel.title: Choose a small next step
mentalModel.content: Connect a realistic change to a specific goal rather than making a vague promise.

ruleBlocks.title: Group activities by purpose
ruleBlocks.content: Distinguish endurance, strength, flexibility, recovery, and everyday movement.

ruleBlocks.title: Use precise frequency language
ruleBlocks.content: Combine jeden Tag, zweimal pro Woche, selten, regelmäßig, and seit with clear time information.

ruleBlocks.title: Discuss balance, not perfection
ruleBlocks.content: Include movement, rest, sleep, food, motivation, and individual limits.

tables.title: Habit Check
rows: Ich gehe mittwochs direkt nach der Arbeit.

examples.de: Ich fahre fast jeden Tag mit dem Fahrrad zur Arbeit.
examples.en: I cycle to work almost every day.

examples.de: Seit drei Monaten trainiere ich regelmäßig im Verein.
examples.en: I have been training regularly at the club for three months.

examples.de: Nach dem Training brauche ich genügend Zeit zur Erholung.
examples.en: After training I need enough time to recover.

commonMistakes.wrong: Ich mache Sport zwei Mal in Woche.
commonMistakes.correct: Ich mache zweimal pro Woche Sport.
commonMistakes.reason: Pro Woche is the standard frequency phrase.

commonMistakes.wrong: Describe health as one perfect routine.
commonMistakes.correct: Discuss realistic habits and personal conditions.

comparisons.summary: Könnte and sollte turn observations into suggestions.
The communication lesson frames advice politely and specifically.
